concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-paypal-setup-paypal-direct-merchants]] — 2026-09-15-captured direct-merchant PayPal test/live sandbox, Customer Area and seven-day permission-link setup guide, with default capture/recurring configuration and stated Active-status timing; account status is not shopper consent, token or payment-outcome proof.
warnings: Direct-merchant setup page says recurring is enabled by default, while separately read PayPal Web Component page conditions direct-merchant recurring on Vault permissions and strongly recommends explicit shopper permission; do not collapse configuration into recurring readiness.
Same-business-day Active status is the source's expected timing, not a verified current activation or payment capability.
